# design-qa

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Select checks for the actual changed component/route. Validate supported token
formats only where the app uses them. Inspect keyboard/focus, contrast, state,
wrapping, scrolling, and relevant themes. Reuse app regression/snapshot coverage.
Do not install a release-wide matrix for a small fix. Give helpers explicit
targets, inspect coverage, and distinguish skipped tools from passing checks.
